summary_en: Shizuoka Financial Group initiated a share buyback program of up to 4.0 million shares or 10.0 billion yen, representing 0.8% of outstanding shares, to be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13 to December 23, 2026, aimed at improving capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast, Revision of Final Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase), and Determination of Matters Related to Share Repurchase
translation_en_brief:
Shizuoka Financial Group announced on November 10, 2026, that its Board of Directors has decided to implement a share buyback program of up to 4.0 million shares or 10.0 billion yen, whichever is reached first. This represents approximately 0.8% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), calculated as 4,000 thousand shares divided by 526,243 thousand shares as of September 30, 2026. The buyback will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 13 to December 23, 2026.

The company stated that the primary purpose of this share repurchase is to achieve further improvement in capital efficiency. This decision came alongside the company's announcement of upward revisions to earnings forecasts for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, with consolidated ordinary profit revised up to 173.0 billion yen from 167.0 billion yen and net income attributable to parent company shareholders increased to 120.0 billion yen from 115.0 billion yen. The company also raised its dividend forecast, increasing the final dividend per share by 5 yen to 59 yen, resulting in a full-year dividend of 113 yen, a 33-yen increase from the previous year.

As of September 30, 2026, the company held 53,885,746 shares of treasury stock against 526,243,323 shares of outstanding stock excluding treasury shares.
